topic: Paying a spouse's hidden tax debt vs filing for Innocent Spouse Relief (Wyatt vs Rhea)

scenes.narration: The IRS chased her for taxes her ex-husband secretly hid. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom beside a giant IRS notice and a hidden pile of money, comic burst banner reads HIDDEN TAX, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wyatt and Rhea each discover tax fraud on joint returns.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man wyatt and woman rhea in the courtroom, each discovering fraud on joint tax returns, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The IRS can hold both spouses liable for joint returns.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a glowing tax form on the courtroom bench labeled JOINT RETURN BOTH LIABLE, a gavel beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wyatt assumes he must pay his ex-spouse's hidden tax debt.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man wyatt sighing while paying an IRS bill labeled EX-SPOUSE HIDDEN DEBT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He drains his savings to settle a debt he never caused.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man wyatt emptying a piggy bank labeled SAVINGS to cover a debt he never caused, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rhea learns about Innocent Spouse Relief from a tax advisor.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman rhea learning from a tax advisor, a brochure labeled INNOCENT SPOUSE RELIEF, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She files IRS Form 8857 before the strict deadline passes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman rhea filing a tax document labeled IRS FORM 8857, a deadline calendar circled, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rhea documents that her spouse hid the income from her.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman rhea organizing evidence folders stamped SPOUSE HID INCOME, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Months later, Wyatt has paid a debt that wasn't his.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man wyatt looking at an empty wallet, a paid IRS notice beside him marked NOT HIS DEBT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His savings are gone with no way to recover them.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man wyatt beside an empty piggy bank, a note reads SAVINGS GONE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The IRS grants Rhea relief and clears her of liability.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman rhea holding an IRS letter stamped RELIEF GRANTED, smiling with relief, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: File Form 8857 for Innocent Spouse Relief before the deadline. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads FILE FORM 8857 BEFORE DEADLINE, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
